result.summary: The page is generally visually coherent, but one restaurant displays an obvious broken data value and the fixed bottom navigation obscures content near the bottom of the screen.

issues.description: The Smash Bros Burgers card shows “€NaN delivery,” exposing an invalid or missing delivery-fee value.
issues.suggestion: Provide a valid delivery fee, or display a fallback such as “Free delivery” or “Delivery fee unavailable” when the value is missing.

issues.description: The fixed bottom navigation overlaps the second popular restaurant card, hiding part of its image and content.
issues.suggestion: Add sufficient bottom padding to the scrollable page so cards can be fully scrolled above the navigation bar.

issues.description: The horizontal category carousel and fastest-restaurant carousel are visibly cut off at the right edge, including a partial category pill and truncated restaurant card.
issues.suggestion: Ensure the clipped content is clearly presented as a horizontally scrollable carousel, or adjust spacing and affordances so the continuation is intentional and discoverable.
